result.title: DuoCL: Dual-Path Online Continual Learning
result.summary: Online continual learning (OCL) requires learning from a data stream whose arrival rate is independent of model training speed. When training cannot keep pace, computationally expensive gradient-based methods update less frequently, limiting adaptation. Analytic methods reduce this overhead, but their frozen backbones cannot adapt representations to changing distributions. We propose DuoCL, a dual-path OCL framework whose fast analytic path accumulates feature statistics from every incoming minibatch while its slow path periodically adapts the backbone. The slow path adjusts its sample count to the available compute budget without interrupting fast-path learning. Feature alignment compensates for drift in the accumulated classifier statistics. Across four datasets and three computational budgets, DuoCL improves online accuracy by an average of 9.67 percentage points over the strongest gradient-based baseline in each setting. DuoCL consistently outperforms analytic learning under distribution shifts, with gains of up to 4.00 percentage points on CIFAR-C, and achieves higher accuracy than prior methods across disjoint class-incremental, domain-incremental, and Si-Blurry settings.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 DuoCL 双路径在线持续学习框架：快路径用解析方法对每个到达的小批次累积特征统计并即时更新分类器，慢路径按可用算力周期性地调整主干，并以特征对齐补偿累积统计的漂移。
AI.relevance_reason: 快慢双时间尺度更新、按算力预算调整慢路径样本量，可能为 LVR 中低成本的潜状态持续更新与周期性重编码、以及 THINK/STOP 的计算预算分配提供可核查线索；但任务是持续学习而非视觉推理，联系较间接。
